heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely and maybe a rumble thunder, except diminishing by midnight in the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the low to mid 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph and gusting to 20 mph, except gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Variable clouds in the northern mountains, with the chance of a sprinkle; otherwise breezy with decreasing clouds. Highs in the mid to upper 70s south and in the Champlain and northern Connecticut valleys, low to mid 70s elsewhere north. West winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Partly cloudy. Lows mainly from the mid 40s to around 50, except low to mid 50s in far southern New Hampshire, and in the Champlain and Hudson valleys. Northwest winds 5 to 15 mph.
